title: India-US Bilateral Trade Deal Final Stage Par Hai, Piyush Goyal Ka Bayan
summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal ne bataya hai ki India aur US ke beech trade deal aakhiri daur me hai aur iska roadmap taiyar ho raha hai.
key_points: Piyush Goyal ne India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 me di jankari.
India aur US ke beech trade deal ab culmination ke kafi kareeb hai.
Pehle negotiation me rukawat ban raha process ab final shape le raha hai.
USTR report ke mutabiq deal hone par tariff 25% se ghat kar 17% ho sakta hai.
body: Union Commerce aur Industry Minister Piyush Goyal ne bataya ki India aur US ke beech bilateral trade deal final hone ke kafi kareeb pahunch gayi hai. Unhone kaha ki jis process aur pathway ki wajah se pehle baat aage nahi badh pa rahi thi, woh ab shape le raha hai.

Minister Goyal ne ye baat Friday ko India Debt Capital Market Summit 2026 ko virtually address karte hue kahi. Unke mutabiq dono deshon ke beech chal rahi lambi baat-cheet ab sahi disha me aage badh rahi hai.

Ye bayan US Trade Representative (USTR) ki haal hi me aayi report ke baad aaya hai. Is report me India se hone wale imports par 25 percent tariff ka proposal tha, jise bilateral deal hone par 17 percent par cap karne ka pravdhan rakha gaya hai.
why_it_matters: Is trade deal ke poora hone se dono deshon ke beech vyapar ko naye avsar milenge. Lower tariff cap hone se bhartiya exporters ko Asian competitors ke mukable faayda mil sakta hai.
